title: invwarp
description: Use FSL Invwarp to invert a FNIRT warp

absolute.description: Use absolute warp convention (default): x' = w(x).

relative.description: Use relative warp convention (default): x' = x + w(x).

jacobian_min.description: Minimum acceptable jacobian value for constraint (default 0.01).

jacobian_max.description: Maximum acceptable jacobian value for constraint (default 100.0).
jacobian_max.title: Jacobian max
